title: Systematic Theology: An Introduction to Biblical Doctrine
author: Wayne Grudem
excerpt: An exceptionally clear, thorough, and accessible introduction to systematic theology from a Reformed, evangelical standpoint, emphasizing scriptural support and practical application.

title: The Holiness of God
author: R.C. Sproul
excerpt: R.C. Sproul's classic work helps readers understand God's majesty and holiness, shaking up ordinary perspectives of divine character and illuminating why holiness is essential to the Gospel.

title: The Bruised Reed
author: Richard Sibbes
excerpt: A masterwork of Puritan comfort that displays Christ’s gentle heart towards weak and struggling believers, encouraging discouraged souls with the tender mercy of Jesus.

title: The Deep Things of God
author: Fred G. Sanders
excerpt: An engaging invitation to experience Christian theology through the lens of the Trinity, connecting deep doctrines directly to everyday Christian joy and worship.
